_comment: Producer-owned, exact-command scope. This zero-ceiling template grants nothing. Balance must be <=15 minutes old. commandSha256 hashes UTF-8 JSON argv after executable with ensure_ascii=False and separators=(comma,colon). allowedOperations supports generate:create or upload:create only. uploadScope is none (no media input), or an object with files [{path: workspace-relative, sha256: exact hash}] and mediaIds [explicit existing UUIDs]. Local media auto-uploads are writes too. Chained/wrapped/ambiguous writes are refused. No artifact acceptance is implied.
